title: AutoTools+
description: Automatically switches to the best tool, eats food when hungry, and places torches in the dark.
body:
# AutoTools

Play smarter with three powerful automations that handle the boring stuff for you.

## Features
- Auto Tool Switch — detects what block you're looking at and switches to the fastest tool in your hotbar
- Auto Eat — automatically eats food from your hotbar when your hunger drops low
- Auto Torch — places a torch from your hotbar when the light level gets too dark

## Controls
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| J | Toggle Auto Tool |
| K | Toggle Auto Eat |
| L | Toggle Auto Torch |
| ; | Open Config |

## Installation
1. Install Fabric Loader
2. Install Fabric API
3. Drop `autotools-1.0.0.jar` into your mods folder

Client side only. Works on any server!
